g.text: Wait for 2 s hold in Idle
Device scans for networks, then opens the hotspot with the setup page
Phone joins the open hotspot; QR opens the setup page
Operator selects the network and enters the password of a protected network
Device joins the selected network; the page shows the progress
Page shows the join error; device scans again with the hotspot open
Device stores the credentials; a failed save is retried once
Page shows the result; device closes the hotspot and the setup page;
On cancel or timeout the page shows a notice and the device closes the hotspot;
Start takes priority: stop setup safely before audio.
